Order service pool configuration and pool wait/acquire metrics
candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No direct Postgres telemetry; pool exhaustion inferred from client-side pool size/idle attributes and DependencyUnavailable errors.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated postgres.save_order failures with pool size 5 and 0 idle, followed by order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502s on /v1/checkout. Logs and metrics corroborate 502s and ~2s latency on checkout. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion.
